items.headline: Venezuelan Relief Efforts Underway as Rescue Teams Extract Survivors from Devastated Areas.
items.teaser: Rescue teams are working tirelessly in Venezuela's capital to pull survivors from the rubble after two powerful earthquakes struck the re…
items.story:
Rescue teams are working tirelessly in Venezuela's capital to pull survivors from the rubble after two powerful earthquakes struck the region, killing at least 32 people and leaving many more trapped. The earthquakes, which occurred in quick succession, levelled several buildings and caused widespread destruction, prompting authorities to declare a state of emergency. Emergency services are racing against time to reach those buried beneath the debris, with rescue efforts hindered by the scale of the devastation. The full extent of the damage is still unclear, but initial reports suggest that hundreds of people may be affected.

The earthquakes are the latest in a series of natural disasters to affect Venezuela, which has been struggling to cope with the aftermath of recent floods and landslides. The country's fragile infrastructure and lack of resources have made it difficult for authorities to respond to these disasters, exacerbating the humanitarian crisis. The capital, in particular, is vulnerable to earthquakes due to its location in a seismically active region, and the city's buildings and infrastructure are often poorly equipped to withstand powerful tremors. The government has faced criticism in the past for its handling of natural disasters, and the current crisis is likely to put further pressure on the authorities.

According to official reports, at least 32 people have been killed in the earthquakes, with many more injured or missing. The rescue efforts are being led by the Venezuelan emergency services, with support from international aid agencies and neighbouring countries. The authorities have set up emergency shelters and are providing food, water, and medical care to those affected by the disaster. The government has also announced plans to deploy additional troops and equipment to the affected areas to support the rescue efforts. As the search for survivors continues, officials are warning that the death toll may rise in the coming days.

The earthquakes have sparked a wave of concern and solidarity from around the world, with many countries offering assistance and support to the affected communities. The international community is closely monitoring the situation, and aid agencies are preparing to deploy teams and resources to support the relief efforts. The Venezuelan government has welcomed the offers of support, and officials are working closely with international partners to coordinate the response. As the rescue efforts continue, the focus is shifting to providing long-term support to the affected communities and rebuilding the damaged infrastructure.

The earthquakes in Venezuela are a reminder of the vulnerability of many countries to natural disasters, and the need for international cooperation and support in responding to these crises. The disaster has also highlighted the importance of disaster preparedness and mitigation, particularly in regions prone to earthquakes and other natural hazards. As the global community responds to the crisis in Venezuela, there are also concerns about the potential for similar disasters in other parts of the world, and the need for greater investment in disaster risk reduction and management.

As the rescue efforts continue, the Venezuelan government is facing questions about its preparedness and response to the disaster, and the long-term implications of the earthquakes for the country's infrastructure and economy. The international community is likely to play a key role in supporting the relief efforts and rebuilding the damaged areas, and there will be a focus on ensuring that the response is coordinated and effective. In the coming days and weeks, the authorities will need to balance the immediate needs of the affected communities with the longer-term goal of rebuilding and recovering from the disaster, and the international community will be watching closely to see how the situation unfolds.

items.story:
As the annual Prime Day sales event gets underway, Walmart is offering over 50 major deals as part of its summer sale, providing consumers with a viable alternative to shopping on Amazon. The retail giant's sale is seen as a direct competitor to Prime Day, with discounts on a wide range of products, including electronics, home goods, and clothing. Walmart's summer sale is available to all customers, regardless of whether they have a membership or not. This move is likely to attract price-conscious shoppers who are looking for bargains without the need for a subscription.

The summer sale is not a new strategy for Walmart, as the company has been offering competitive deals during the summer months for several years. However, this year's sale is particularly noteworthy, given the timing of Prime Day and the sheer number of discounts available. Walmart's decision to launch its sale concurrently with Prime Day is a clear attempt to capitalize on the shopping frenzy and lure customers away from Amazon. By offering similar or even better deals, Walmart is positioning itself as a major player in the e-commerce market.

According to various reports, Walmart's summer sale features discounts of up to 50% on certain items, with some deals offering even deeper savings. The company has also announced that it will be offering free shipping on orders over a certain amount, making it an attractive option for online shoppers. Experts note that Walmart's sale is not limited to online shopping, with many deals available in-store as well. This omnichannel approach is likely to appeal to customers who prefer to shop in person or want to avoid shipping costs.

The reaction to Walmart's summer sale has been largely positive, with many shoppers taking to social media to express their excitement about the deals. Some customers have even reported finding better prices at Walmart than on Amazon, which is likely to be a major blow to the online retailer. The sale is also expected to have a significant impact on the retail market, as other companies may feel pressure to offer competitive deals in order to stay ahead. As the sale continues, it will be interesting to see how Amazon responds and whether Walmart's strategy pays off.

The wider context of Walmart's summer sale is the increasingly competitive retail landscape, where companies are constantly looking for ways to attract and retain customers. The rise of e-commerce has forced traditional brick-and-mortar stores to adapt and evolve, with many turning to online sales and loyalty programs to stay ahead. Walmart's sale is just one example of this trend, as the company seeks to position itself as a leader in the market. The success of the sale will likely have implications for the retail industry as a whole, as other companies take note of Walmart's strategy and consider similar approaches.

As the summer sale comes to a close, it will be important to watch how Walmart's strategy plays out and whether the company is able to attract and retain customers. The company's decision to offer competitive deals and free shipping is likely to have a lasting impact on the retail market, and it will be interesting to see how Amazon and other retailers respond in the coming months. With the holiday shopping season just around the corner, Walmart's summer sale may be just the beginning of a larger effort to establish itself as a major player in the e-commerce market.

items.story:
China is accelerating its shift towards electric vehicles as fuel prices surge due to the disruption caused by the Iran war, with many drivers opting for battery-powered cars to mitigate the impact of rising petrol costs. In Beijing, new EV owner Du Pan is among those who have made the switch, citing soaring fuel prices as the primary reason for abandoning his fuel-powered car. This trend is particularly significant in China, which is already the world's largest electric vehicle market. The country's transition to electric vehicles is expected to have far-reaching implications for the global automotive industry.

The shift towards electric vehicles in China is not a new phenomenon, but the recent surge in fuel prices has accelerated the process. China has been actively promoting the adoption of electric vehicles through various incentives and investments in infrastructure, aiming to reduce its dependence on fossil fuels and mitigate the environmental impact of transportation. The country's electric vehicle market has been growing rapidly, with many domestic manufacturers emerging as major players in the industry. The current trend is expected to further boost the sales of electric vehicles, with many analysts predicting a significant increase in market share.

According to recent data, more than half of all new car sales in China are now battery-powered, with the country's crude oil imports falling sharply. Analysts suggest that this decline is largely due to the increased adoption of electric vehicles, as well as efforts to diversify the country's energy sources. The Chinese government has set ambitious targets for the adoption of electric vehicles, aiming to have a significant proportion of new car sales be battery-powered by the end of the decade. Official statements from the government have emphasized the importance of transitioning to electric vehicles, citing both environmental and economic benefits.

The surge in fuel prices has had a significant impact on drivers in China, with many opting for electric vehicles as a more cost-effective option. The reaction from stakeholders has been largely positive, with many manufacturers investing heavily in electric vehicle technology. The market response has been equally enthusiastic, with many consumers eager to take advantage of the incentives and benefits offered by electric vehicles. However, some experts have raised concerns about the potential strain on the country's energy grid, as well as the need for further investment in charging infrastructure.

The trend towards electric vehicles in China has significant implications for the global automotive industry, with many countries likely to follow suit. The shift towards electric vehicles is expected to have a major impact on the environment, with reduced emissions and improved air quality. Regional implications are also significant, with many countries in Asia and beyond likely to be affected by China's transition to electric vehicles. The global market for electric vehicles is expected to continue growing, with many manufacturers investing heavily in new technologies and infrastructure.

As the situation continues to evolve, many experts are watching to see how the Chinese government will respond to the growing demand for electric vehicles. Upcoming decisions on incentives, infrastructure, and regulation are likely to have a significant impact on the industry, with many stakeholders eager to see how the government will balance the needs of manufacturers, consumers, and the environment. The future of the electric vehicle market in China is likely to be shaped by a combination of factors, including government policy, technological advancements, and changing consumer preferences, making it an important trend to watch in the coming years.

items.headline: Kenyan lawmakers approve contentious legislation amidst lingering social unrest concerns.

items.story:
Kenya's lawmakers have approved a controversial package of financial measures, two years after deadly Gen Z protests forced the government to withdraw a tax bill, in a move aimed at raising $770 million ahead of the 2027 elections. The decision was made by the country's parliament, which is dominated by President William Ruto's administration. The government has argued that the new bill is necessary to address the country's financial needs. The approval of the bill has sparked concerns among various stakeholders, who fear it may lead to increased taxation and economic hardship.

The protests that took place two years ago were sparked by a proposed tax bill that was seen as unfair and burdensome by many young Kenyans. The demonstrations turned violent, resulting in the loss of lives and property damage, and ultimately forced the government to withdraw the bill. The current administration has been keen to avoid a similar backlash, but the approval of the new financial measures has already raised concerns among some sections of the population. The government has been trying to balance its need to raise revenue with the need to avoid imposing excessive burdens on its citizens. The country's economy has been facing significant challenges, including a large budget deficit and high levels of debt.

According to official statements, the new package of financial measures is designed to raise $770 million in revenue, which will be used to fund various government programs and projects. The government has argued that the measures are necessary to ensure the country's economic stability and growth. The bill includes a range of provisions, including changes to taxation laws and regulations. President Ruto's administration has stated that the measures will help to reduce the country's budget deficit and improve its economic competitiveness. The government has also promised to implement measures to protect vulnerable sections of the population from the impact of the new financial measures.

The approval of the bill has been met with mixed reactions from various stakeholders, including business leaders, civil society organizations, and ordinary citizens. Some have expressed concerns that the new measures will lead to increased taxation and economic hardship, particularly for low-income households. Others have welcomed the move, arguing that it is necessary to address the country's financial challenges and ensure its economic stability. The business community has been particularly vocal, with some leaders warning that the new measures could harm the country's economic competitiveness and deter investment. The government has promised to engage with stakeholders and address their concerns.

The approval of the bill has significant implications for Kenya's economy and politics, both in the short and long term. The country is facing significant challenges, including a large budget deficit, high levels of debt, and a struggling economy. The new financial measures are likely to have a major impact on the country's economic trajectory, and could influence the outcome of the 2027 elections. The government's ability to implement the measures effectively and address the concerns of stakeholders will be crucial in determining the country's economic future. The international community will also be watching closely, as Kenya is a key player in regional and global affairs.

The next steps will be crucial in determining the impact of the new financial measures on Kenya's economy and society. The government will need to implement the measures effectively, while also addressing the concerns of stakeholders and protecting vulnerable sections of the population. The opposition and civil society organizations are likely to continue to scrutinize the government's actions, and may challenge the measures in court if they believe they are unfair or unconstitutional. The international community will also be monitoring the situation closely, and may offer support or criticism depending on the outcome. As the country moves forward, it will be important to watch how the government balances its need to raise revenue with the need to protect its citizens and ensure economic stability.

items.story:
Venezuela's interim president, Delcy Rodriguez, has declared a state of emergency after two powerful earthquakes struck the country, causing widespread destruction and fear of a high casualty toll. The earthquakes, measuring 7.2 and 7.5 magnitude, occurred near the capital city of Caracas, with the first quake hitting on a day that will be remembered for the devastating impact it had on the nation. Thousands are feared dead or buried in the rubble, and rescue efforts are underway to search for survivors. The earthquakes were followed by at least 20 aftershocks, further exacerbating the damage and chaos.

The earthquakes are a significant blow to a country already struggling with economic and political challenges. Venezuela has been experiencing a severe economic crisis, with high inflation and shortages of food and medicine, making it difficult for the government to respond to the disaster. The country's infrastructure is also in a state of disrepair, which has likely contributed to the extent of the damage caused by the earthquakes. The declaration of a state of emergency will allow the government to mobilize resources and personnel to respond to the disaster, but it remains to be seen how effective the response will be.

According to the US Geological Survey, the earthquakes were centered near Caracas, with the epicenter of the first quake located at a depth of approximately 10 kilometers. The surveys also reported that the aftershocks were widespread, with some areas experiencing shaking of up to 5.5 magnitude. Official statements from the government have confirmed that thousands of people are feared dead or injured, and that rescue efforts are being hampered by the extent of the damage. Experts have warned that the full extent of the damage may not be known for several days, as rescue teams struggle to reach remote areas.

The international community has begun to respond to the disaster, with offers of aid and assistance pouring in from around the world. Neighboring countries have offered to send rescue teams and supplies, and international organizations such as the Red Cross have begun to mobilize resources to support the relief effort. The reaction from the public has been one of shock and sadness, with many taking to social media to express their condolences and offer support to those affected. The government has also announced plans to establish shelters and distribution centers for those affected by the disaster.

The earthquakes have significant regional and global implications, as Venezuela is a major oil producer and a key player in regional politics. The disaster is likely to have a major impact on the country's economy, which is already struggling, and may also have implications for regional stability. The international community will be watching closely as the situation develops, and will likely be called upon to provide significant support to the relief effort. The disaster also highlights the need for greater investment in disaster preparedness and response, as well as the importance of building resilient infrastructure to withstand natural disasters.

As the situation continues to unfold, the focus will be on the rescue efforts and the provision of aid to those affected. The government will face significant challenges in responding to the disaster, and will need to work closely with the international community to ensure that those in need receive the support they require. In the coming days, attention will turn to the longer-term implications of the disaster, including the impact on the economy and the country's infrastructure. The international community will be watching closely to see how the government responds to the disaster, and how the country begins to rebuild and recover from this devastating event.

items.headline: Crude Oil Values Plummet to Pre-Conflict Levels Amid Revival of Maritime Trade in the Gulf Region.
items.teaser: Oil prices have fallen to their lowest level since before the US-Iran war, as shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has resumed, …
items.story:
Oil prices have fallen to their lowest level since before the US-Iran war, as shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has resumed, easing concerns over global crude supplies. The price drop is a significant development, indicating a return to prewar levels, with major benchmarks such as Brent crude and West Texas Intermediate crude experiencing notable declines. This shift in the oil market comes after a period of heightened tensions in the region, which had driven up prices due to fears of supply disruptions. The resumption of shipping through the strategic waterway has helped to alleviate these concerns, contributing to the downward trend in oil prices.

The recent conflict in the region had led to a surge in oil prices, as investors and traders worried about the potential impact on global energy supplies. The Strait of Hormuz, a critical chokepoint for oil shipments, had been a particular focus of concern, with any disruption to traffic through the waterway likely to have significant effects on the global oil market. However, with the resumption of shipping traffic, these concerns have begun to ease, and oil prices have responded by falling back toward prewar levels. This development is a welcome relief for consumers and businesses, who had been facing higher energy costs due to the increased prices.

According to industry data, oil prices have fallen by several dollars per barrel, with some benchmarks experiencing declines of as much as 10% or more. Official statements from major oil-producing countries have also helped to reassure markets, with assurances that supplies will continue to flow uninterrupted. Experts have noted that the return of oil prices to prewar levels is a significant development, indicating a return to stability in the global energy market. The decline in oil prices is also expected to have a positive impact on the broader economy, as lower energy costs can help to boost consumer spending and business investment.

The decline in oil prices has been welcomed by consumers and businesses, who had been facing higher energy costs due to the increased prices. The impact of the price drop is expected to be felt across the economy, with lower fuel costs likely to benefit industries such as transportation and manufacturing. However, the decline in oil prices may also have negative effects on some oil-producing countries, which had been benefiting from the higher prices. The reaction of these countries to the price drop will be closely watched, as they may seek to adjust their production levels or implement other measures to support their economies.

The resumption of shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz is a significant development, not just for the oil market, but also for regional stability. The waterway is a critical artery for global trade, with a significant proportion of the world's oil supplies passing through it. The easing of tensions in the region is a positive development, and the return of oil prices to prewar levels is a welcome consequence. However, the situation in the region remains complex, and any further developments will be closely watched by markets and policymakers. The impact of the decline in oil prices will also be felt globally, with potential effects on inflation, economic growth, and trade balances.

As the oil market continues to evolve, investors and traders will be watching closely for any further developments that may impact prices. The upcoming meetings of major oil-producing countries will be closely watched, as they may provide further guidance on production levels and supply policies. Additionally, the ongoing efforts to improve regional stability and security will be critical in maintaining the free flow of oil supplies through the Strait of Hormuz. With the oil market having returned to a sense of normalcy, attention will now turn to the broader economic implications of the price drop, and how it may impact growth, inflation, and trade in the months ahead.

items.headline: SpaceX Deploys Additional Satellites in Starlink Constellation via West Coast Launchpad.
items.teaser: SpaceX successfully launched a Falcon 9 rocket from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California on Wednesday evening, continuing the expans…
items.story:
SpaceX successfully launched a Falcon 9 rocket from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California on Wednesday evening, continuing the expansion of its Starlink network with the deployment of 24 satellites into orbit. The launch marked another significant milestone in the company's efforts to establish a vast constellation of satellites providing global internet connectivity. According to reports, the rocket lifted off without any issues, and the satellites were successfully deployed into their intended orbits. This latest launch demonstrates SpaceX's ability to maintain a rapid pace of deployment for its Starlink network.

The Starlink network is a crucial component of SpaceX's ambitious plan to provide high-speed, low-latency internet services to remote and underserved communities around the world. With thousands of satellites already in orbit, the company is making steady progress towards achieving its goal of establishing a global network. The development of the Starlink network has significant implications for the future of global communication, as it has the potential to bridge the digital divide and provide access to information and opportunities for millions of people. SpaceX's innovative approach to satellite technology and launch operations has also sparked interest and investment in the space industry, driving growth and innovation.

The Falcon 9 rocket used in the launch is a reliable and versatile vehicle that has been used in numerous SpaceX missions, including previous Starlink launches. The rocket's ability to carry heavy payloads into orbit makes it an ideal choice for deploying large constellations of satellites like Starlink. According to SpaceX, the 24 satellites launched on Wednesday are part of the company's ongoing efforts to expand its network and improve its services. The company has stated that it plans to launch many more satellites in the coming months and years, with the goal of establishing a network of thousands of satellites in low-Earth orbit.

The launch was widely watched and closely followed by space enthusiasts and industry experts, who praised the successful deployment of the satellites and the continued expansion of the Starlink network. The launch also generated significant interest among local residents, who gathered to watch the rocket lift off from Vandenberg Space Force Base. As the Starlink network continues to grow and expand, it is likely to have a significant impact on the space industry and the global economy, driving innovation and investment in the years to come. The success of the launch is also a testament to the skill and expertise of the SpaceX team, who have worked tirelessly to develop and deploy the Starlink network.

The expansion of the Starlink network has significant implications for the global space industry, as it drives innovation and investment in satellite technology and launch operations. The development of large constellations of satellites like Starlink is also likely to have a major impact on the environment, as it raises concerns about space debris and the long-term sustainability of space exploration. As the space industry continues to evolve and grow, it is likely that we will see more developments like the Starlink network, driving progress and innovation in the years to come. The success of the launch is also a significant milestone for Vandenberg Space Force Base, which has played a crucial role in the development of the US space program.

As SpaceX continues to expand its Starlink network, the company is likely to face significant challenges and opportunities in the years to come. With plans to launch many more satellites and establish a global network, the company will need to navigate complex regulatory environments and address concerns about space debris and sustainability. The success of the launch is a significant step forward for the company, but it is only one part of a much larger effort to establish a global network and provide high-speed internet services to communities around the world. items.story:
The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has concluded its response to a recent hantavirus outbreak, as the risk of further transmission in the country diminishes. This development comes after a group of 18 Americans, who were exposed to the virus on a cruise ship, were released from quarantine in Nebraska. The quarantine, which lasted for six weeks, was lifted after the individuals showed no symptoms of the disease. The CDC's decision to end its response is a significant indication that the outbreak is under control.

Hantavirus is a rare but potentially deadly disease that is typically spread through contact with infected rodents or their droppings. The recent outbreak in the US was linked to a cruise ship, where a group of passengers were exposed to the virus. The CDC, in collaboration with state and local health authorities, responded quickly to the outbreak, implementing quarantine measures and conducting contact tracing to prevent further transmission. The agency's efforts have been successful in containing the outbreak, and the risk of hantavirus transmission in the US is now considered low.

According to official statements, the CDC's decision to end its response was based on a thorough assessment of the situation, including the results of laboratory tests and epidemiological investigations. The agency has reported that there have been no new cases of hantavirus linked to the cruise ship outbreak, and the individuals who were quarantined have been cleared to return to their normal activities. The CDC has also emphasized the importance of continued vigilance and surveillance to prevent future outbreaks. Experts have praised the agency's response, citing its swift and effective actions as a key factor in controlling the outbreak.

The end of the quarantine and the CDC's response has been welcomed by the individuals who were affected, as well as by the wider community. The lifting of the quarantine has brought a sense of relief to the community, and has allowed the individuals who were affected to return to their homes and families. The CDC's decision has also been seen as a positive development by the cruise ship industry, which had been impacted by the outbreak.

The hantavirus outbreak in the US has highlighted the importance of global cooperation and surveillance in preventing and responding to infectious disease outbreaks. As the CDC ends its response to the hantavirus outbreak, the agency will continue to monitor the situation and conduct surveillance to prevent future outbreaks. The US public health system will also continue to work with international partners to share information and best practices in preventing and responding to infectious disease outbreaks. items.story:
A doctor has debunked the recent social media trend of using gelatin as a supposed weight loss aid, often referred to as "nature's Ozempic". This trend has been gaining traction online, with many users claiming that drinking gelatin can help with weight loss and improve overall health. However, medical professionals are urging caution and warning that there is no scientific evidence to support these claims. The trend is believed to have originated from the popularity of the medication Ozempic, which is used to treat type 2 diabetes and has been shown to have weight loss effects as a side benefit.

The gelatin trend has been fueled by social media platforms, where users have been sharing their own experiences and recipes for gelatin drinks. Many of these users claim that drinking gelatin has helped them lose weight and improve their digestion, among other benefits. However, dietitians and medical professionals have been quick to point out that there is no scientific evidence to support these claims. Gelatin is a protein derived from animal bones and connective tissue, and while it does have some nutritional benefits, it is not a proven weight loss aid. The trend has also raised concerns about the potential health risks of using gelatin as a quick fix for weight loss.

According to experts, the idea that gelatin can aid in weight loss is based on the fact that it is a protein that can help keep people feeling full. However, this effect is not unique to gelatin and can be achieved through other protein-rich foods. Additionally, there is no evidence to suggest that gelatin has any specific properties that would make it more effective for weight loss than other protein sources. Dietitians have also warned that relying on gelatin as a weight loss aid can lead to an unbalanced diet and potentially cause other health problems. The FDA has not approved gelatin as a weight loss supplement, and medical professionals are advising people to approach this trend with caution.

The reaction to the gelatin trend has been mixed, with some people swearing by its benefits and others expressing skepticism. Many users on social media have reported trying the gelatin drink and claiming that it has helped them lose weight, but these claims are largely anecdotal and have not been scientifically proven. On the other hand, many medical professionals and dietitians have spoken out against the trend, warning that it is not a sustainable or healthy way to lose weight. The trend has also raised concerns about the potential for misinformation and false advertising on social media platforms.

The gelatin trend is part of a larger phenomenon of social media-fueled health trends, where unproven remedies and supplements are often touted as miracle cures. This has raised concerns about the spread of misinformation and the potential for people to be misled into trying unproven and potentially harmful remedies. Medical professionals and regulatory agencies are working to combat this trend by promoting evidence-based health information and warning people about the potential risks of unproven remedies. The gelatin trend is just one example of the need for skepticism and critical thinking when it comes to health information online.

As the gelatin trend continues to unfold, it remains to be seen whether it will have any lasting impact on the way people approach weight loss and health. Mathrubhumiറോബിൻ ബസ് - എംവി‍ഡി തർക്കം കടുക്കുന്നു, പതിവ് പോലെ സർവീസ് നടത്തുമെന്ന് ഗിരീഷ്; ഫേസ്ബുക്കിലൂടെ വെല്ലുവിളി Asianet News Malayalamപെർമിറ്റില്ല, നിയമവിരുദ്ധമായി സർവീസ് നടത്തി; റോബിൻ ബസ് വീണ്ടും തടഞ്ഞ് എംവിഡി Kerala Kaumudiപെര്‍മിറ്റില്ല; റോബിന്‍ ബസ് തടഞ്ഞ് മോട്ടോര്‍ വാഹന വകുപ്പ് Siraj Dailyപോര് തീരുന്നില്ല;റോബിൻ ബസ് വീണ്ടും പിടിച്ചെടുത്ത് എംവിഡി; പിന്നിൽ കൃത്യമായ അജണ്ടയെന്ന് ബസുടമ News Malayalam 24x7

items.headline: Shorter front-leg strides can be an early warning sign of dementia in senior dogs
items.teaser: Scientists have shown that the stride length of the front legs (but not the hind legs) of senior and geriatric dogs decreases as their co…
items.story: Scientists have shown that the stride length of the front legs (but not the hind legs) of senior and geriatric dogs decreases as their cognitive performance worsens. In contrast, chronological age itself was a poor predictor of stride length. A similar reduction in step length has been well documented in people with dementia.
